tagline: macOS HTTPS MITM proxy for developers

transparent_proxy.title: Transparent Proxy
transparent_proxy.desc: No per-app proxy configuration. pf redirects all traffic from your phone automatically.

app_classification.title: App Classification
app_classification.desc: Traffic automatically grouped by app: WeChat, Douyin, Alipay, and more.

https_decryption.title: Full HTTPS Decryption
https_decryption.desc: MITM with dynamically generated certificates. See encrypted traffic in plain text.

keyboard_tui.title: Keyboard-Driven TUI
keyboard_tui.desc: Developer-friendly terminal UI. All 9 tabs accessible without a mouse.

yew_gui.title: Yew GUI (Beta)
yew_gui.desc: New desktop GUI built with Rust. No Node.js dependency.

rule_engine.title: Rule Engine
rule_engine.desc: Direct, Proxy, Reject, MapRemote, MapLocal — full control over traffic.

get_started.title: Get Started

steps.step2: Connect phone to same WiFi as Mac
steps.step3: Set phone's gateway and DNS to Mac's IP
steps.step4: Export CA cert from Certs tab → AirDrop to phone
steps.step5: Trust CA in iOS Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust
steps.step6: Run proxybot-tui and press r to start

get_started.find_ip_hint: Find your Mac IP: ipconfig getifaddr en0

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.diagram:
Phone --[WiFi]--> Mac (pf redirect :80/:443) --> ProxyBot (MITM) --> Internet
                                                              |
                                                              +--> DNS Server (log queries, correlate with apps)
